hourly.origin: RTI to BMRCL by Vivek Mathew; mirrored on OpenCity (data.opencity.in/dataset/bmrcl-station-wise-ridership-data)
hourly.definition: Passengers boarded at the station per hour; start-of-hour bucket; 83 stations; 1-18 Aug and 1-30 Sep 2025
hourly.limitations: Entries rows are absent (not zero) before a station opened; 19-31 Aug 2025 not covered by the RTI

hourly.license: ODbL (Vonter repo); OpenCity lists CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 - check before non-academic use
hourly.origin: RTI to BMRCL by Vivek Mathew
hourly.definition: Passengers alighted at the station per hour; zero-filled before station opening in this file
hourly.limitations: Pre-opening zeros are NOT genuine observations; masked using entries-derived opening date

daily.origin: Daily BMRCL published figures by ticket mode
daily.definition: Daily network ridership = smart cards + tokens + NCMC + group tickets + QR (system-wide, all ticket modes)
daily.limitations: 256 calendar days missing; QR total column inconsistent with app columns from Sep 2025 to Jul 2026 (app sum used)

od.definition: Station-pair hourly trips 1-18 Aug 2025 with fare; exploratory only (not used for core forecasts)
